game.name: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2009 (USA)
game.desc: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2009 is a hunting game for Xbox 360. Go into the forest with a rifle or two, an equally powerful handgun, bait, bear collars, tranquilizer darts and camouflage your scent to flush out your prey. Many dangerous animals will be used to complete your kill list, but you'll need to be patient to find them and take them down.
game.genre: Lightgun Shooter, Hunting, Hunting and Fishing
